correctness.rationale: The crown graph has 20 off-diagonal edges, a connected 9-edge gauge tree and 11 independent chord masks; the five diagonal frequency bits are inert. Every 11-bit signing has signed derangement permanent determined by 44 permutations. Exhaustively recomputed the 2048 exact integer signed sums: histogram 338 zeros and 1710 nonzero masks. An independent 2048-point integer Walsh-Hadamard transform of the nonzero-support indicator has |H| counts {6:960,10:360,14:44,18:70,22:360,26:240,46:12,338:1,1710:1}, sum |H|=27996, yielding ||P||_1=||P||_infty=27996/2048=6999/512 with the quotient kernel supported in the annihilator. Translation-averaging any projection onto the translation-invariant convolution range does not enlarge endpoint norms and is the unique commuting range projection. Thus the canonical projector is globally optimal, not merely among convolution projectors. The two independent integer derivations in packaged checker were inspected; separate calculations successfully reproduce the histogram.
